orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Long-Burn Drive Mk1, a hull mount (outward is up): a long slender bell on a plate, a fuel drum with a level window on each side piped into the bell base, a pale-blue exhaust; inside the Concord core with its lights pale blue and a big fuel-efficiency dial (red, amber and green arc, a trembling needle) with level lamps. Damaged: the bell lip dented and hanging, the bell cracked and sputtering, the right drum cracked and weeping pale fuel, the dial glass cracked and its needle stuck, lamps red, sparks. Disabled: the bell bent over at the neck, a drum split and slid off, the dial dead and cracked, the repair hatch popped. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
